svg.aria-label: With Huffman codes 0 10 0 11 0 10 0 0 for a b a c a b a a, one read position is handed from thread to thread, because t(i) learns where its code starts only after t(i-1) has decoded, so 8 threads take 8 steps in turn. With fixed 2-bit codes, every thread computes its start as 2 times t and all 8 decode in 1 step together.
svg.text: 1 huffman, a thread knows its start only once the one before it is done
2 fixed width, thread t starts at bit 2 x t, nobody waits
3 same 8 symbols, 8 steps in turn or 1 step together
huffman codes take 8 steps in turn; fixed-width codes take 1 step together
blue numbers mark the bit where each thread starts reading
